predictions.prediction_text: In high volatility regimes, buying end-of-month (EOM) expiring options with 20–25 deltas that sit on round-number strikes is more likely to pay off.
predictions.expected_result: Options with 20–25 deltas and round-number strikes expiring at month-end will, on average, deliver higher realized returns than comparable non-round strikes or non-EOM expiries during the high volatility period.
